name: DMA Two-Layer Supply Chain Intelligence Network
description: A two-layer ontology for the Disruption Mitigation Agent: Layer 1 models the operational supply chain (vendors, items, purchase orders, sales orders, inventory, customers) and Layer 2 models the decision-trace intelligence memory (episodes, mitigation decisions, facts, reflections, concepts, policies, goals, recommendations). Cross-layer edges anchor institutional memory to specific supply chain entities.
author: yaorugan
